output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-e55689cf8a52] is only a metric name, but it sits in the list that the section intro [ev-1f419676f177] introduces with "These metrics will be changed". That gives the subject (the metric `cortex_prometheus_notifications_dropped_total`) and the change (a prefix rename to `loki_prometheus_notifications_dropped_total`).
